method: Week 3 evaluation Section 5.4 random search, seed 0, 200000 draws, best of run 1 (scenario-level)
grouping_rule: Scenario-level grouping. Same-map scenarios are separate crash sites (76-758 m apart). Map-level split rejected: the best of all 540 map-level splits costs 12.71 (timing term 6.75, one fold with median accident time 11.5 s) vs 7.395 for the scenario-level split, so maps are not enough for 3 balanced folds. Map sharing is stated as a limitation.
global_median_definition: median of the 14 scenario medians (6.675 s)
